createSeed.content:
This seed was derived from your Passport Prime Master Key, so it's automatically protected by your existing backup. Manual backup is optional.

The new seed can be retrieved at any time in the Legacy Mode settings.

intro.content: Legacy Mode lets you manage assets beyond Bitcoin, directly on Passport Prime. Create a new seed or import one from an existing wallet to get started.

To keep an external backup, view the seed words in the app settings before continuing.

The next screen will show your seed words.
Anyone requesting you expose these words outside of this device will gain full control over your funds. Take care.

wallet.PassphraseModal.content:
A passphrase acts as a second layer of security to protect your funds.

To access funds protected by a passphrase, you must reenter the exact same characters.

It is crucial to back up your passphrase to avoid loss of funds.
wallet.confirmPassphrase.content: Your passphrase will be erased upon shutdown, or can be manually cleared by returning to this screen.
wallet.confirmPassphrase.content2: You can save your Passphrase to an unused Keycard. The Passphrase is encrypted with your Master Key and can only be decrypted with that Master Key.
wallet.confirmPassphrase.labelExplainer: Enter a label for this passphrase account. This label can be changed at any time in the Account Details screen.
wallet.enterPassphrase.content: Type with care. All passphrases are valid. Ensure you back up your passphrase.
